limitations: The dated satellite is26February2025 and shows excavation. Retrieval12October2026 does not make it a current completed-building photo.

Street-centre lines, parking and neighbouring footprints come from live OSM. Building heights use OSM levels/height when present; otherwise two storeys are an explicit unverified proxy. Facades, roof equipment and parked cars are proposed visualization detail.

Road widths7.4m tertiary/6.4m residential/4.6m service and6.0m roundabout lane are visual reconstruction estimates, not a measured survey. They retain source alignment but should not be used as construction dimensions.

New local registration uses the source-plan roundabout and a fitted current OSM circle. The inherited model bearing62.2deg is retained and visually checked with rail/site orientation. No geodetic registration or positional accuracy better than the supplier8.47m is claimed.
The source ground and ramp remain unchanged. Extended grades smoothly continue the model levels; no external topographic survey or DEM was obtained.
External-ramp plan/profile chainage is a visualization reconciliation. B01 edge match is preserved but full vehicle headroom is not certified.
A neutral ground apron extends beyond mapped geometry only to support the display and remove floating cut edges. It carries no site-data claim.
Satellite imagery is retained as an attributed research reference, never baked into the model. Rendered references preserve map geometry; later AI images must be labelled conceptual.
scope: Source-registered streets, actual neighbouring footprints, parking and rail/station corridor; source detailed site/ramp retained
